policy: Every compatible longgun has mandatory rail plus two functional mods. Each sidearm has one independent slot; no carbine conversion or cross-hand synergy. Existing underbarrels and action/projectile budgets are preserved.
balancing: Keep existing actor-only compensation ceilings; recalculate complete weapon raw power and independent expected B/C. No new crit, slay, shot type, projectile count, lifecycle, skill or Nano mods.
